levels.surface: سعد بن عبد الله بن أبي خلف

notes: «حدثني أبي وأخي» names no one: both are relation links, and «جميعاً» marks the four co-transmitters meeting at سعد بن عبد الله.
«عامر بن عبد الله» is in the scene («كنت وعامر ... عند أبي عبد الله»); he speaks but the report relays the Imam's words, so he is not stored.
The Imam speaks inside the narrator's story, so «أبي عبد الله» is the last link (owner ruling 5). The blessing «(ع)» is not part of the surface.
